imageEvidence.scope: Actual unmodified raw PNGs viewed individually. Sixteen Chinese dark narrow and sixteen English light regular, plus eight Japanese light regular high-risk forms. Width is the recorded class-specific minimum, not a universal pixel width.

observations.detail: COLMAP executable placeholder specifies drive E despite supported D-drive and C-only location policy.
observations.proposedMinimumNextStep: Add a real dialog placeholder regression in three locales, then use drive-neutral executable selection wording. Root owns production/catalog changes.

observations.detail: Existing-job combo shows Running/Liveness Unverified while the selected job report and monitor show Paused/Session Ended.
observations.hypothesis: The combo is refreshed from m->jobs while selected-job presentation is refreshed from m->report. A real transition regression is needed before treating this as the confirmed cause.
observations.proposedMinimumNextStep: Use owned observer process/job fixture to transition to paused/ended and assert selected combo and current observed report do not contradict each other; preserve jobId, raw state and provenance.

observations.detail: Export Retained Logs is not directly visible in the minimum-width TaskDetailsDialog image. Native toolbar overflow was not operated; image alone cannot establish that the action is unreachable.
observations.proposedMinimumNextStep: Real-window keyboard/overflow reachability check if this surface is next selected.

staticChain: refreshJobs while connected chooses inspect, not list (ExistingTrainingDialog.cpp:145).
finishHelper list branch replaces m->jobs (line217); inspect branch validates identity then replaces only m->report (line225).
refreshPresentation renders combo from m->jobs (lines272-273), but detailed state from m->report (lines277-279).
Worker inspect_job reads recorded state and liveness from actual job/lease; list_jobs is a bounded projection of inspect_job and is not a mutating repair.

Existing RuntimeDecouplingUiTests actual owned CPU lease already transitions unverified -> live -> paused/ended, checks clean process exit, and captures observer-ended. It does not assert selected combo caption matches final report.

minimalRemoteRedPlan.integrationPoint: Existing observer-ended captureUiFormMatrix optional validator at RuntimeDecouplingUiTests.cpp:321; keep all original pause/clean-exit/non-resume assertions.
minimalRemoteRedPlan.expectedJobId: existing owned fixture id of 32 'a' characters
minimalRemoteRedPlan.assertion: Exact full selected caption/tooltip must combine the existing fixture outputName/id with independently expected paused/ended labels; selected id and full public report must remain unchanged.
minimalRemoteRedPlan.noPreemptiveRefresh: Do not add list refresh or change values/text before observing RED; it would hide the actual path under review.

existingTrainingStateTracer.proposedFixAfterRed: Root may project the already validated current inspect report into the matching attached job's displayed summary, preserving raw job identity/record and all unrelated list rows. This requires real remote RED first; no production or worker mutation made here.

English wide GS2Mesh form and explanatory paragraph fit; fixed actions visible.
Chinese dark narrow export options and preservation/coordinate explanation readable. Editable output path is horizontally scrolled normally; Export/Cancel remain visible.
